description: Contributions to general IIP y/y, percentage points, monthly from April 2024: weight × (index − index a year earlier) ÷ general index a year earlier, at MoSPI's 2022-23 weights; parts: electronics and electrical (NIC 26, 27), non-electronics manufacturing (other 21 divisions), and mining, electricity and gas, water and waste; general_yoy is MoSPI's published rate. Calculated by Asia Decoded. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/iip/in_iip_contrib.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly IIP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India IIP contributions (calc.)
